label: What it is
what_it_records: The vendor's own one-line description of the product.

label: Plans and list prices
what_it_records: Every plan and its regular monthly list price in USD, as shown on the vendor's pricing page.

label: Starting price (USD a month)
what_it_records: The lowest regular monthly price of a paid plan, as a number. Promotional prices are in promotion.

label: Billing note
what_it_records: Annual vs monthly billing, per-business or per-entity pricing, and what the price is based on.

label: Promotion
what_it_records: An introductory discount shown on the pricing page on the check date.

label: Free trial
what_it_records: Trial length and terms as stated.

label: Bank connections
what_it_records: Live bank and card feeds, or how transactions get in.

label: Works with
what_it_records: Whether it is its own ledger or works inside another accounting system.

label: AI features
what_it_records: The AI features the vendor lists, in its own terms.

label: AI assistant
what_it_records: The name of the chat or agent assistant if the vendor names one.

label: Auto-categorization claim
what_it_records: A categorization rate the vendor publishes. Blank if none is published.

label: Human service
what_it_records: Bookkeeping or finance staff offered by the vendor, and its price if published.

label: Multiple companies
what_it_records: How additional companies or clients are priced.

label: Statement and document capture
what_it_records: Whether PDF bank statements or other documents can be read into the books, as the vendor describes it.

label: Availability
what_it_records: Country or entity limits stated by the vendor.
